compatibility_rules: the base release is a full taxonomy/search release (macrofungi scope, 52881 searchable concepts)

each supplement is a registry_supplement that MUST be loaded on top of its declared base and every entry in depends_on; standalone loading is rejected by database/taxonomy/reconciliation/supplement_loader.py
no previously published release ID may refer to two byte-distinct artefacts; the SUPERSEDED entries above are the only tolerated form of ID lineage
search-cache membership is defined solely by the base release's taxon_external_id.jsonl; supplements never contribute to the search cache
external-mapping tuple (source_system, namespace, external_id) resolves to at most one sporely_taxon_id — enforced by production schema UNIQUE constraint
identification snapshots are immutable; later resolution updates the resolution_link only
